To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the NNLO vertex corrections are free of IR divergences, (ii) the scale dependence of the tree amplitudes at NNLO is reduced, but not as much as at NLO, (iii) the NNLO results are consistent with the NLO results, and (iv) the NNLO corrections are moderate.
the NNLO vertex corrections are numerically moderate and the factorization scale uncertainty of the tree amplitudes at NLO and NNLO is similar.

the real part of NNLO vertex corrections in the topological tree amplitude of charmless hadronic decays of B mesons is small, that the factorization scale ambiguity of the tree amplitude is reduced by the NNLO vertex corrections, and that the phenomenologically interesting ratio | C /T | is not enhanced by the real part of these vertex corrections.

the calculation of the real part of 2-loop vertex functions in the context of QCD factorization for charmless B decays.
the NNLO calculation for charmless hadron B decays.
the calculation of the NNLO vertex corrections to the factorization formulas for the tree amplitudes of charmless hadronic $B$-decays in the Standard Model.

the NNLO corrections are not large enough to change the picture of charmless hadronic decays drawn from NLO analyses.

the NNLO vertex corrections are not large enough to change the picture of charmless hadronic decays of B mesons, which is obtained from NLO calculations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NNLO corrections are not as large as expected from the NLO calculation, but that they are still sizable.

the NNLO corrections in the topological tree amplitude are small, but not negligible.
